home.title: Welcome
home.intro: Soon you will be able to enter your details for the transfer project and see your documents here.

status.unavailable: The server cannot be reached right now. Please try again later.

code.intro: Enter the personal activation code from your letter, your sheet or your message.
code.label: Activation code

birthDate.intro: For your security, please enter your date of birth.
birthDate.label: Date of birth

address.introEmail: Enter the private email address your activation link was sent to.
address.introSms: Enter the private mobile number your activation link was sent to.

channel.intro: Choose a private contact. We will send you login codes and portal notifications there. Do not use your work email address.
channel.help: Only you should have access to it.

oneTimeCode.introEmail: We have emailed you a six-digit code. It is valid for 15 minutes.
oneTimeCode.introSms: We have texted you a six-digit code. It is valid for 15 minutes.
oneTimeCode.label: Confirmation code

done.title: Your access is active
done.text: You will also receive a confirmation at your contact.
done.recoveredText: Your new contact replaces the previous ones. You will also receive a confirmation there.

errors.code_invalid: This code is not valid. Please contact your transfer company ({{contact}}).
errors.before_cutoff: Activation is no longer possible for you. Please contact your transfer company ({{contact}}).
errors.knowledge_check_failed: That does not match. Please check it; after several wrong attempts the code is locked.
errors.one_time_code_invalid: The confirmation code is wrong or no longer valid. Check it or request a new one.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please try again later.
errors.channel_in_use: This contact cannot be used. Please choose another one.
errors.channel_invalid: Please enter a valid private email address or mobile number.
errors.delivery_failed: The message could not be delivered. Please check what you entered.
errors.delivery_unavailable: Messages cannot be sent right now. Please try again later.
errors.step_not_allowed: This step is not possible right now. Please start again with your code.
errors.session_expired: Your session has expired. Please enter your code again.
errors.birth_date_format: Please enter a valid date in the format DD.MM.YYYY.

login.title: Log in
login.intro: Enter the private email address or mobile number you confirmed for the portal. We will send you a login code.
login.addressHelp: The address your code was sent to.
login.sent: If this address belongs to an account, we have sent a six-digit code. It is valid for 15 minutes.

errors.one_time_code_invalid: The code is wrong or no longer valid. Check it or request a new one.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please try again later.
errors.channel_invalid: Please enter a valid email address or mobile number.
errors.delivery_unavailable: Messages cannot be sent right now. Please try again later.

channels.title: Your contact details
channels.removeOne: Your consent for this contact ends. We will no longer send codes or messages there.
channels.removeLast: This is your last contact. If you remove it, you will be logged out and can no longer log in to the participant portal. Your transfer company will still help you in person, by phone or by letter, and can give you a new access code if you need one.
channels.loggedOut: The contact is removed and you are logged out. For new access, please contact your transfer company.
channels.expired: Your session has expired. Please log in again.

upgrade.title: New consent for this contact
upgrade.intro: We have extended the consent text: through this contact we can also remind you when something is open in the portal. Agreeing is voluntary. If you don't agree, nothing changes and you can still log in.
upgrade.done: Thank you, your consent is saved.

consents.title: Your consents
consents.intro: Here you can see which consents you have given us and whether they still apply.
consents.empty: You have not given any consent.
consents.failed: Your consents could not be loaded. Please try again later.
consents.portalContact: You withdraw your consent for a contact by removing that contact.
